title: Protection mode engaged
shortDescription: Marantz AVR shut down into PROTECT - almost always a shorted speaker wire.
fullDescription:
Marantz SR-series and Cinema-series AVRs share Denon's HDAM output architecture. PROTECT triggers when the amplifier detects a short, overcurrent, or DC offset on any channel.

First suspect stray speaker wire strands between + and - terminals.

fixSteps.title: Disconnect all speakers
fixSteps.instruction: Remove every lead from binding posts.

fixSteps.title: Power on empty
fixSteps.instruction: If PROTECT clears, the short is in speaker wiring.

fixSteps.title: Reattach one channel at a time

whenToCallPro: PROTECT with no speakers - send to Marantz service.

faq.a: Yes - Marantz and Denon share parent company and amp design.

title: Thermal shutdown
shortDescription: Internal heatsink too hot; unit cut power.
fullDescription: Tightly stacked AV furniture, dusty vents, or 4-ohm loads cause Marantz AVRs to overheat. Typical after an hour of loud cinema playback.

faq.a: Yes for enclosed racks - thermostat-controlled fan adds lifespan.

title: HDMI handshake error
shortDescription: Black screen or snow due to HDMI negotiation failure.
fullDescription: Same 2020 HDMI 2.1 bug as Denon affects Marantz SR7015/SR8015/AV7706. Eligible for hardware adapter/chipset swap.

fixSteps.title: Request HDMI 2.1 hardware fix
fixSteps.instruction: Marantz offers the chipset swap program.

faq.a: No - 2022+ Cinema models use corrected chipset.

title: Audyssey calibration failed
shortDescription: Calibration aborts with check mic or polarity error.
fullDescription: Same Audyssey MultEQ XT32 as Denon. Fails on mic issues, background noise, or out-of-phase speakers.

faq.q: Can I buy Audyssey app instead?
faq.a: Yes - $19.99 app gives more control than on-screen calibration.

title: HEOS service offline
fullDescription: Marantz uses HEOS like Denon. Offline state disables internet radio and most streaming providers.

fixSteps.title: Re-add device
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and re-pair in HEOS app.

title: Video works but no audio
shortDescription: Silent playback with valid video signal.
fullDescription: Often source outputs bitstream the AVR can't currently decode, or mute is engaged, or eARC handshake failed.

fixSteps.title: Switch source to PCM
fixSteps.instruction: Test with PCM to rule out bitstream.

title: Check speaker wire warning
shortDescription: Startup impedance test found a short or missing load.
fullDescription: Marantz checks every channel on power-up. Stray strands or unplugged leads trigger CHECK SP WIRE.

faq.a: Yes - all Marantz AVRs have 5-way binding posts.

title: Firmware update failed
fullDescription: Power loss or WiFi drop during a Marantz firmware update can brick temporarily. Recovery usually succeeds if left plugged in.

title: Porthole display off or dim
shortDescription: Signature Marantz porthole display dim or completely off.
fullDescription: Marantz users often accidentally press the DIMMER button cycling through brightness levels to off. Also can indicate a failed front panel after many years.

faq.a: Some sources send CEC dim commands - disable in menu if unwanted.

title: Subwoofer silent in setup
shortDescription: Sub connected but no output during playback.
fullDescription: Common causes: sub set to Bypass/LFE only with stereo source sending no LFE, crossover too low, or cable to the wrong jack.

fixSteps.title: Set crossover 80 Hz
fixSteps.instruction: Sets LPF of LFE for music too.

fixSteps.title: Swap RCA cable
fixSteps.instruction: Test with a known-good subwoofer cable.

faq.a: LFE+Main duplicates low frequencies to mains and sub for louder bass.

title: Protection Mode Active
shortDescription: Marantz shut amp output to protect itself.
fullDescription: Marantz PROTECT mode triggers shutting down audio output due to short or overheat.

fixSteps.title: Disconnect speakers
fixSteps.instruction: Remove all wires, power on - if normal, find shorting wire.

fixSteps.title: Ventilate
fixSteps.instruction: Allow 30 min cooldown with clear vents.

whenToCallPro: If PROTECT persists with no speakers.

faq.a: Yes - shared platform with Denon AVRs.

title: HDMI Input Issue
shortDescription: Source connected but no picture/sound through receiver.
fullDescription: Marantz reports no HDMI signal despite cable and source connected.

fixSteps.title: Verify input
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm selected input matches actual port.

fixSteps.title: Reseat HDMI
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and replug HDMI both ends.

faq.a: Connect source directly to TV to isolate AVR.

title: Account Auth Error
fullDescription: HEOS account login on Marantz fails to authenticate - password or service issue.

fixSteps.title: Re-login
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > HEOS > Account > sign out then in.

videoSearchQuery: Marantz HEOS Account Login Failed fix

faq.a: Re-login to HEOS may also require re-linking service.

title: Mic Position 1 Error
fullDescription: Audyssey aborts at first listening position - mic level or speaker output issue.

fixSteps.title: Mic at ear height
fixSteps.instruction: Place mic at primary listening position, ear height.

fixSteps.title: Verify wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm all 5/7 channels wired with correct polarity.

videoSearchQuery: Marantz Audyssey Failed at Position 1 fix

title: eARC Atmos Stream Lost
shortDescription: Atmos via TV apps not received.
fullDescription: Atmos from TV streaming apps not reaching Marantz over eARC.

fixSteps.title: Ultra HS HDMI
fixSteps.instruction: Use 48Gbps certified HDMI from TV eARC to AVR.

fixSteps.title: TV bitstream
fixSteps.instruction: Set TV digital out to bitstream/auto.

videoSearchQuery: Marantz eARC Atmos Not Working fix

faq.a: Atmos via TV apps usually requires eARC; ARC limited to DD+.

title: Zone Configuration Issue
fullDescription: Zone 2 audio not outputting - source assignment or amp assign issue.

fixSteps.title: Use analog or HEOS source
fixSteps.instruction: Zone 2 supports analog/HEOS - HDMI Zone 2 only on flagships.

faq.a: Yes - AVR's surround back amps reassign to Zone 2.

title: Standby Pass-through Issue
shortDescription: HDMI signal lost when AVR in standby.
fullDescription: HDMI Pass Through feature does not work - in standby TV loses signal from source.

fixSteps.title: Enable Pass Through
fixSteps.instruction: HDMI Setup > HDMI Pass Through > On.

fixSteps.title: Map source
fixSteps.instruction: Set Pass Through Source to current source.

videoSearchQuery: Marantz HDMI Pass-Through Failed Standby fix

faq.a: Slightly higher standby power when enabled.

title: Network Module Offline
fullDescription: Marantz HEOS module shows offline though AVR is on.

title: DC Voltage Detected
shortDescription: DC voltage on speaker output detected.
fullDescription: DC OFFSET error indicates internal amp fault placing DC on speaker terminals.

faq.a: Yes if uncorrected - PROTECT prevents damage.

title: Display Brightness
shortDescription: Front display very dim or off.
fullDescription: Front panel display dimmed by user setting or auto-dim.

fixSteps.title: Press DIMMER
fixSteps.instruction: Cycle DIMMER button on remote to brighten.

videoSearchQuery: Marantz Display Dim All Status fix

faq.a: Yes - some users disable display fully.
